cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
echo "=== grep silero in repo ==="; grep -rIl -i silero scripts docs bot .github *.py *.sh 2>/dev/null | head -15
echo "=== lines ==="; grep -rIn -i silero scripts 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-170 | head -15
echo "=== cron / services ==="; crontab -l | grep -i silero; systemctl list-units --all 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "silero|tts" | head
echo "=== procs ==="; ps -eo pid,etime,cmd | grep -i silero | grep -v grep | cut -c1-150
echo "=== venv/models contents ==="; ls -la --time-style=long-iso /opt/silero-models | head; ls /opt/silero-venv/lib/python*/site-packages | grep -i -E "^(torch|silero|torchaudio|omegaconf)" | head
echo "=== latest data/blocks mp3 ==="; ls -la --time-style=long-iso data/blocks_gemini/*.mp3 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls data | grep -i -E "voice|tts|audio" | head
echo "=== recent use (access time of models) ==="; stat -c '%x %n' /opt/silero-models/* 2>/dev/null | head -3
